DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

HISTOPATHOLOGY

                                                       

A)          SPECIMEN  :   Endoscopic tissue taken from oesophageal growth.

 

B)          GROSS FINDINGS   :   Multiple grey-brown tissue bits. (All embedded).

 

1)   PROCEDURE : Endoscopic resection

 

2)   TUMOR :

A)   Tumor Site: Mid esophagus,

                (25cm from the incisor).

B)   Histologic type : Adenosquamous carcinoma.

            C) Histologic Grade: G2 , moderately differentiated.

            D) Tumor size : Cannot be determined: (Not mentioned in the upper GI

                                      endoscopic report).

            E) Tumor Extent : Invades lamina propria.

                  

3)   Lymphovascular Invasion :

   Not identified in the section examined.

 

4)   Perineural invasion :

       Not identified in the section examined.

5)   Margins:

Cannot be commented

6)   Additional findings :

High grade squamous dysplasia.

 

 

COMMENT : 1) Clinical correlation.

                     2) IHC may be considered.

 

ENCLOSED  :  One section

                         (SDC/MB/10 /25)

SPECIMEN                           :   Gall bladder.

SPECIMEN                         :   Appendix.

 

 

 

GROSS FINDINGS               :   Appendix measured 6.6cm in length.

                                                    Lumen was found to patent.

                                                   No granuloma or malignancy seen.

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

HISTOPATHOLOGY

 

                                                                                                           

SPECIMEN   :   Upper G.I Endoscopic Biopsy from Antral growth (Multiple biopsy taken).

 

GROSS FINDINGS   :   Multiple gray white tiny tissue bits. All embedded.

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS    :  I) Procedure : Endoscopic mucosal resection.

 

                                                    II) Tumor site : Ulceroproliferative growth at the antrum

                                                                            involving the pyloric ring.

 

                                                   III) Tumor size : Can not be determined.

 

                                                  IV) Histological type : Adenocarcinoma.

A)   Lauren classification → Intestinal type.

B)   Based on WHO → Tubular.

 

    V) Histologic Grade : G2 → Moderately differentiated.

 

    VI) Microscopic extent of tumor :

         . Tumor invades lamina propria.

     .  Muscularis mucosa is not included in the biopsy specimen.

 

VII) Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified.

 

VIII) Perineural invasion: Not identified.

 

XI) Additional pathologic findings :

1)    Intestinal metaplasia.

2)    Low grade glandular dysplasia.

 

COMMENTS  : Clinical correlation suggested.

 

ENCLOSED   :  One slide and block.

                          (SDC/BM/65/24)

 

 

 

 

 


DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

HISTOPATHOLOGY

 

 

                                                                                                         

SPECIMEN    :   Endometrial biopsy material.

 

 

 

GROSS FINDINGS    :   Chocolate – brown loose tissue pieces altogether measuring

                                        (3.0 x 1.5) cm. Whole embedded.

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS    :  Serial section shows a polypoid tissue lined by epithelium on

                                                     three sides. The endometrial glands show various

                                                     architecture. Some are cystically dilated and majority are

                                                     tortuous with secretory change. The stroma is voluminous

                                                     and shows pseudodecidualisation. Thick walled and ectatic

                                                     thin walled blood vessels are also noted. Areas of

                                                     haemorrhage and fibrin deposits are present. 

                                                    

                                                    No granuloma or malignancy seen.

 

 

 

IMPRESSION  : Features are consistent with adenomatous polyp of endometrium showing 

                          pill endometrial change.

 

                      

 

ENCLOSED    :  One slide and block.

                           (SDC/SB/17/25)
